key_points.point: Core team established for the project
key_points.details: A core group of team members identified, with some flexibility for others to join based on availability

key_points.point: Data quality issues from multiple sources
key_points.details: Reporting data comes from multiple sources with varying quality; some SSIS jobs are outdated and not ideal for CDP consumption

key_points.point: Raw data preferred over manipulated data
key_points.details: Preference to consume raw data from SSIS processes rather than end results to allow selective use of data pieces

key_points.point: Guice is a reporting engine, not a long-term priority
key_points.details: Guice functions like Power BI for drag-and-drop report building; not critical for long-term roadmap and alternatives are being explored

key_points.point: Guice has technical limitations with joins
key_points.details: Guice cannot perform joins across multiple data sources; data must be joined at SQL level in DWRPT before presenting to Guice
Common Client ID implemented to improve table joins; discovered data cleanliness issues
Reports generated in Guice are used for client-facing purposes; built by internal product team (primarily Jacob), non-technical users
Data organized by application schemas (e.g., SL for Social Logic, ML for MediaLogic) to prevent data conflation

key_points.point: Guice embedded via iframe with security controls
key_points.details: Guice reports embedded in company portal using iframe with login requirements and specific security rules

key_points.point: Power BI available but resource constraints
key_points.details: Power BI available but lack of internal Power BI developers; offshore team utilized to avoid taking engineering resources

action_items.action: Get access to the data warehouse reporting database
action_items.context: Ron was working on getting access to the data warehouse reporting database which has all the tables and data that powers the analytics in Guice

action_items.action: Evaluate and implement alternatives to Guice
action_items.context: Guice is not important for longer-term roadmap and the team is already looking at alternatives to replace it with something better

action_items.action: Address data quality issues and implement Common Client ID joins
action_items.context: Data discovered to not be as clean as desired; Common Client ID has been implemented to join tables better across multiple sources

action_items.action: Review SSIS jobs and determine which raw data pieces to consume
action_items.context: SSIS processes are outdated; need to pick out pieces of raw data versus manipulated data for CDP build
